launch_gate.reason: Do not compete with the active Inter-X formal evaluation or train against an unaccepted tokenizer.

data.augmentation: released original plus left/right swap; per-draw caption, exclusive crop, coordinate anchor and output order
data.online_tokenization: process/crop/pad first, then encode with the frozen selected HHC InterHuman VQ
data.validation: frozen official-val-only 480 requests in five complete batches of 96
data.validation_multimodality: 100 prompts from the same seeded val-only order, 11 repeats and 10 official evaluator pairs; diagnostic only

model.rationale: Reuse the recovered high-performing HHC topology and change dataset/sequence support only; InterHuman supplies neither beta/gender nor Inter-X contact schedules.

training.mask_detail: retain pkeep=0.5 random replacement, change only to two sorted cosine kinematic ratios
training.historical_tail_contract: explicit END at floor(length/4), PAD afterward; neither is included in loss
training.batch_rationale: Prelaunch 2026-10-01 resource check with selected frozen VQ, cached CLIP/InterCLIP and FP32 Adam moments: repeated real 8-sample data, physical64 forward/backward 0.2183s and 14.713GiB reserved versus 8x8 accumulation 0.2625s/6.297GiB. Keep effective batch64; this is not a quality or bitwise-gradient equivalence claim. No earlier MGT run was trained with the provisional 8x8 setting.
training.exact_resume: resume only after complete optimizer steps with sampler draw position, optimizer/scheduler, RNG and W&B run id restored

automatic_validation.multimodality_seed_contract: SHA256-derived seed per frozen prompt and repeat; sample output is invariant to generation batch grouping
automatic_validation.main_validation_seed_contract: SHA256-derived repeat-0 seed per frozen official-val request; checkpoint-selection output is invariant to generation batch grouping
automatic_validation.rng_contract: validation is observational and restores Python, NumPy, Torch CPU and CUDA RNG state

pilot_decision.continue_same_run: validation FID/retrieval improve and training/gradient telemetry remain healthy; continue without reinitialization toward 300k
pilot_decision.diagnose_before_continue: flat or regressing official-val quality, non-finite metrics, collapsed channel accuracy, or unstable gradient/weight norms
